providerVerdict.reason: The base policy is not independently qualified; its verdict cannot establish a candidate pass.

pairedSet.interpretation: Metric medians, effects, and p/Holm values are copied from the provider summary; this draft independently verifies receipt hashes/source roles and recomputes same-side control bands.

observer.limitation: GetSystemTimes covers the observed host aggregate, including benchmark and observer; it is context only and does not establish external contention, a quiet host, or causal preemption.
observer.collectionBracketP95Method: nearest-rank; sorted duration at one-based rank ceil(0.95*N)

privacy: Projection excludes absolute paths, runner names, machine identity, PIDs, process names/payloads, native PE bytes, and raw receipt bodies.
